title: The Sorting Santa Claus Hat App
author: Nathan Tabor
original: • The Sorting Santa Claus Hat App: An interactive sorting experience led by Atnas Claus (mother of Santa Claus) alongside Mr. Elf, Mrs. Elf, Ms. Elf, and Reindeer hats—revealing that the South Pole is the secret manufacturing plant for the North Pole.
